proposal.reason: Main change updates GIN device-side utility memory/fence instruction mnemonics to the new `ppu.*` forms in `gin_troce_utils.h`, which is a direct GIN API/backend behavior surface. Additional network review is needed because the same semantic instruction changes are also applied in the Net IB DOCA GPUNetIO device verbs backend (`transport/net_ib/.../doca_gpunetio_dev_verbs_common.cuh`), an independently substantive transport/network implementation path.
